title: The Riot in Ephesus
description: In Ephesus, the silversmith Demetrius incites the craftsmen against Paul because his preaching threatens the cult of Artemis, and the whole city falls into chaos until the town clerk calms the crowd.

versions.title: The Riot in Ephesus
versions.description: The silversmiths in Ephesus rise up against Paul because his preaching threatens the cult of Artemis.
